reference.citation: Ordinary least squares (multivariable). Reference impls: base R stats::lm / summary.lm and statsmodels OLS. Data: eyes-closed-foam COP path length (PhysioMoCap::swayMetrics) on age and Trail Making Test A, Santos & Duarte (2016) BDS.
reference.description: re-fits the multiple OLS regression of eyes-closed-foam sway on age and TMT-A with base R lm and statsmodels OLS and confirms multipleRegression reproduces the coefficients, R-squared and F bit-for-bit; also reports the age-dominant / TMT-non-significant split and the model fit
